items.question: Which customer bought the most units in orders with the status 'cancelled'? Give the name.
items.answer:
SELECT c.name
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC
LIMIT 1;

items.question: What is the average number of units per order for orders from 2024?
items.answer:
SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_units_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024'
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
);

items.question: How many customers placed orders in more than one distinct year?
items.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT substr(order_date, 1, 4)) > 1
)

items.question: How many customers placed orders in all three years 2023, 2024 and 2025?
items.answer:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2023' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
);
items.sql:
